---
pagetitle: Avner A. Kreps - Teaching
---

I have served as a TA for microeconomics courses at the undergraduate and PhD levels. My average evaluation is a 5.88 out of 6 (N = 463); 89% of evaluations were a 6/6. I was awarded the Northwestern Economics Department's Distinguished TA Award for the 2022-2023 academic year, the only year in which I was eligible to receive it.
